categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang He Chuan Technology Corporation Limited primarily operates in industrial automation, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and application integration of industrial automation core components and overall solutions. Its main products include servo systems, programmable logic controllers (PLC), machine tools, chips, sensors, and related automation equipment. The company serves various industries such as 3C electronics, photovoltaics, lithium batteries, packaging, textiles, logistics, robotics, woodworking, and laser technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes core technologies including servo control systems, motor control, advanced algorithms, high-precision encoders, image recognition sensors, and integrated industrial control chips. It has developed proprietary SIP chips integrating MCU, storage, motion control algorithms, and real-time industrial Ethernet IP. Manufacturing capabilities include in-house die casting, CNC precision machining, electronic assembly, and automated production lines, enabling flexible and high-quality production. The company employs ERP and MES systems to integrate automation and digitalization in production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: He Chuan Technology serves leading enterprises in sectors such as new energy (photovoltaics, lithium batteries), 3C electronics, robotics, logistics, packaging, textiles, and machine tools. Key customers include industry leaders like CATL, BYD, Foxconn Industrial Internet, SF Express, Longi, Jiejia Weichuang, Lead Intelligent, Lens Technology, and Efort. The company provides customized solutions tailored to specific industry needs, enhancing customer loyalty and market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Zhejiang Province and multiple subsidiaries across Chinese cities including Hangzhou, Suzhou, Quzhou, and Dalian. It has expanded its international presence with overseas business in countries such as Germany, Poland, Spain, Turkey, India, Vietnam, Malaysia, Brazil, and has established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore to accelerate global market development.
categories.supply_chain_position: He Chuan Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial automation supply chain. It develops and manufactures core components such as servo systems, PLCs, sensors, and chips, and extends into downstream applications including high-end precision machine tools and integrated automation solutions. The company maintains deep manufacturing capabilities and vertical integration from design to assembly, ensuring control over quality and supply chain flexibility.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product upgrades with significant R&D investment, accounting for 13.59% of revenue in 2023. It focuses on core technologies in 'light, mechanics, electricity, magnetics, and computing,' advancing integrated solutions from core components to digital factories. R&D efforts include developing high-performance servo systems, integrated chips, sensors, and digital manufacturing technologies. The company also emphasizes talent development, enhanced R&D infrastructure, and collaboration with academic institutions to sustain innovation and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: He Chuan Technology generates revenue primarily through the sale of industrial automation products including servo systems, PLCs, machine tools, and chips. The company employs a sales model combining direct sales and distribution channels, with a focus on customized solutions and turnkey projects. Revenue is recognized mainly at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with additional income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international industrial automation giants such as Siemens, Panasonic, Yaskawa, and Mitsubishi, which dominate the high-end market. Domestically, it ranks as the second-largest Chinese brand in the general servo system market with a 3.4% market share, competing effectively on cost, localization, and service. The company is recognized as a leading domestic player capable of competing with foreign brands in mid-to-high-end industrial automation core components.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, He Chuan Technology reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.116 billion, an 18.24% increase year-over-year, driven by expanded sales in the new energy sector and machine tool products. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 53.56 million, down 40.74% due to increased R&D and sales expenses. Total assets reached RMB 2.156 billion, with equity of RMB 1.569 billion. The company maintains a strong R&D workforce of 586 employees, representing 30.63% of total staff, and continues to invest heavily in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: He Chuan Technology differentiates itself through comprehensive industrial automation solutions covering control, drive, execution sensing, and mechatronics layers. It emphasizes high performance, reliability, cost-effectiveness, and localized service. Proprietary technologies such as high-precision encoders, integrated SIP chips, and advanced servo control algorithms provide competitive advantages. The company’s deep manufacturing integration and flexible production enable customized, high-quality products with rapid market responsiveness, supporting customers’ digital transformation and smart manufacturing needs.
